title: Meta's Upcoming Muse Charm Wearable Device Reportedly Priced at $300
excerpt: Reports indicate Meta's upcoming AI wearable device, the Muse Charm, could carry a $300 price tag.
body_html:
Meta is reportedly preparing to launch a new AI wearable device called the Muse Charm. According to recent reports, the upcoming hardware could carry a price tag of $300.

When questioned about the reported pricing details, Meta chose not to deny the information. Instead, the company stated that it will share more details regarding its upcoming artificial intelligence wearable in the near future.
